answer: A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in opal, and dawn reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 179 aliases, and each one needs its own funded lotus account. A farm of 1178 identities would post 1987 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
